description: Land Acquisition - Walgama, Matara D/S Division, Matara District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1605/21, Devinuwara D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired by the government for public purposes. It includes lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents of multiple land parcels, making it clearly focused on land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
